name: @sharedid-edge/module-cmp
description: SharedID Edge module (opt-in): storage consent from the cookies of CMPs without a TCF TC string (Cookiebot, OneTrust, Complianz, CookieYes, iubenda, Borlabs Cookie)

sharedidEdge.name: cmp
sharedidEdge.title: consent from non-TCF CMP cookies
sharedidEdge.summary: Nothing in the payload: a consent provider that reads the consent cookie of a CMP without a TCF TC string (Cookiebot, OneTrust, Complianz, CookieYes, iubenda, Borlabs Cookie). A refusal there denies the SharedID everywhere; a grant allows it where GDPR applies and there is no TC string
